newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Multipolar seeks 50.1 pct Matahari stake.
newsitem.headline: Multipolar seeks 50.1 pct Matahari stake.

text.p: Indonesia retail and information technology company PT Multipolar Corp said on Monday it had bought a 45-percent stake in retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima and plans to buy an additional 5.1 percent.

Multipolar, a member of diversified Lippo Group, said in an advertisement in the Bisnis Indonesia newspaper it would buy the 5.1 percent stake or 23 million shares through a tender with an offer price of 3,200 rupiah per share.
"The offer price of 3,200 rupiah is 25 rupiah above its (Matahari's) highest price achieved on the exchange in the last 90 days before this announcement," the statement said.
Multipolar said it had previously executed its unconditional and irrevocable option to buy a 45-percent stake in PT Mataharijaya Putraperkasa, a major Matahari shareholder.
It gave no details of the purchase.
Multipolar said its tender offer was subject to approval at its extraordinary shareholders meeting on January 30.
PT Mataharijaya Putraperkasa is controlled by Matahari's founder Hari Darmawan, who will be involved in the management of Matahari after the tender offer was done, the statement said.
The underwriter for the tender, PT Lippo Securities, said that Multipolar has the funds to finance the tender.
Multipolar rose 25 rupiah to close at 1,675 rupiah last Friday on 13 million shares, while Matahari fell 175 rupiah to end at 2,725 rupiah on a volume of 1.6 million shares.
